name: Pumpkin Juice
description: This is the best drink for chilly autumn days. Just grab a warm sweater and a steaming hot pumpkin juice and see the raindrops on your windows.

ingredients.name: water or to taste. You can add more if you are looking for something less sweet
honey or maple syrup to taste (optional. I don't add it as I find the apple juice is sweet enough on its own)
